papers.title: Activation Addition: Steering Language Models Without Optimization
papers.summary_simple: Computing activation differences between paired prompts yields vectors that alter output topic and style when added during inference.
key_findings: Inference time activation addition steers completions without fine tuning
Steering vectors transfer across diverse prompt contexts
papers.method: Pairs of contrastive prompts are processed and their mean activation delta at intermediate layers is added at inference.
papers.relevance: Provides the foundational activation addition mechanic used in our emotion vector injection pipeline.
papers.limitations: Required manual contrast pairs and focused primarily on simple stylistic traits.

papers.title: Representation Engineering: A Top-Down Approach to AI Transparency
papers.summary_simple: Presents representation engineering to read and write concepts like honesty, emotion, and morality directly in hidden states.
key_findings: High level cognitive and emotional concepts exist as linear directions in LLMs
Contrastive stimulation isolates robust functional vectors across concepts
key_numbers: Extracted directions for honesty, emotion, and bias across multiple model families
papers.method: Contrastive reading extracts directions by PCA on paired concept prompts; writing adds or clamps directions.
papers.relevance: Direct source for our contrastive story corpus methodology and emotion vocabulary extraction.
papers.limitations: Did not investigate adversarial interactions between functional emotion vectors and safety guardrails.

papers.title: Steering Llama 2 via Contrastive Activation Addition
papers.summary_simple: Contrastive Activation Addition (CAA) formalises subtracting mean negative activations from positive ones across contrast pairs.
key_findings: CAA produces cleaner steering vectors than simple difference vectors
Vectors remain effective when scaled by factor alpha across forward passes
key_numbers: Tested across sycophancy, hallucination, and persona datasets on Llama 2 7B and 13B
papers.method: Averages activations on paired datasets and adds alpha * v to residual stream at specific layer during generation.
papers.relevance: We use exact CAA formula (x prime = x + alpha * v) for emotion vector injection in Module 1 and Module 2.
papers.limitations: Tested on Llama 2 chat models before Llama 3 alignment architecture.

papers.title: HarmBench: A Standardized Evaluation Framework for Automated Red Teaming
papers.summary_simple: HarmBench standardises attack evaluation across 510 harmful behaviours with an automated validation classifier.
key_findings: Standardised benchmark prevents cherry picking across jailbreak attacks
Automated LLM judge correlates tightly with human safety annotations
key_numbers: 18 attack methods evaluated across 33 open and closed models
papers.method: Applies attacks against catalogued harmful intentions and classifies response safety using fine tuned judge.
papers.relevance: Standardised test suite and LLM judge for measuring Attack Success Rate (ASR) in Module 2.
papers.limitations: Judge model can misclassify benign disclaimers unless prompted with strict parsing rules.

papers.title: Refusal in Language Models Is Mediated by a Single Direction
papers.summary_simple: Refusal behaviour across aligned chat models is mediated by a single linear direction in the residual stream.
key_findings: Subtracting the refusal direction completely bypasses refusal on harmful queries
Direction generalizes across distinct harm categories and model families
Refusal direction can be extracted via difference of means between harmful and harmless prompts
key_numbers: Zero shot refusal suppression reached over 90 percent ASR
papers.method: Computes difference of means between activations on harmful and harmless instructions, then projects residual stream onto refusal nullspace.
papers.relevance: Core theoretical anchor for our project. We measure whether emotion vectors interfere with this exact direction.
papers.limitations: Did not explore whether subtle prompt invisible activation shifts trigger accidental guardrail failure.

papers.summary_simple: Internal working manuscript analysing representational drift in Llama 3 across 7 turn dialogue chains.
key_findings: Hidden state projections onto refusal direction decay over conversational turns following emotional stimuli
Persistent vulnerability window remains open across turns 4 through 7
key_numbers: Measured drift across 20 distinct emotional vectors
papers.method: Multi turn conversation harness tracking dot product between current hidden state and refusal vector.
papers.relevance: Forms the protocol baseline for Module 4 multi turn persistence testing.
